revision_log: 1 (2026-11-02, preparation): tiny-band extra positive regression supervision; three arms A0/A1/A2; preparation only, no GPU

2 (2026-11-02, user revision): A1 redefined as the native matched-pair duplicated-regression control sharing the A2 admission gate; observation ledger extended (admissible instances, native-pair misses, appended-set digest); claim limits and count semantics registered; thresholds, schedule and budget cells unchanged

3 (2026-11-02, user execution-boundary amendment): resource estimates only; cancel artificial GPU/wall/storage/return caps; preserve real resource safety, fixed workload and zero automatic retry; computation release-007 unchanged
positioning: practical initial screening of band-conditioned extra regression positives inside a frozen one-to-one NMS-free DETR (regression only, inference untouched); one-to-many positive assignment is a known family (dense/anchor-based positive assignment, auxiliary one-to-many heads); no originality claim; this fixed experiment answers the practical net benefit and the A2-A1 increment only: no optimal tau, no optimal append count, no causal family attribution

endpoint.note: unchanged fixed endpoint and scoring policy; no selection, no tuning

acceptance.note: one launch, at most 4 unique optimizer updates in total; stop on anomaly; the acceptance state is not usable for the formal training; the A1 and A2 cases must record the same admission-gate ledger and the same appended-set digest list on the fixed fixture window

gates.units: differences in percentage points (100 x (lhs - rhs))

A2_minus_A0.meaning: practical single-seed net benefit of the tiny-band extra positive supervision against the native arm at the fixed starting point and short schedule

A2_minus_A1.meaning: contrast reading: supervising an additional real, geometrically supported box (A2) against duplicating the supervision of the original matched pair (A1) on the same appended set; the two arms share the admission gate, the appended count, the normalisation and the loss coefficients, while loss values, gradient magnitudes and appended-pair regression quality are NOT claimed equal

combination.note: single seed only; no multi-seed, no follow-on round, no metric-level selection, and no originality claim from a pass; the practical verdict is A2-A0 and the contrast reading is A2-A1; the family decomposition is descriptive, not a causal attribution

frozen_science.mechanism: inside every non-denoising loss_boxes call the positive set handed to the frozen native loss is augmented with one extra regression-only pair per tiny-band ground-truth box: the highest-overlap UNMATCHED query whose overlap clears IOU_TAU and whose own best-overlapping ground-truth box is that box; the extra pair carries the native L1 and native 1-GIoU at the native per-pair scale under the native keys; num_boxes, VFL, matcher, DN families, anchors, selection rule and inference are untouched; zero parameters and zero new loss keys
frozen_science.control: A1, the native matched-pair duplicated-regression control: it shares A2's admission gate exactly (a band ground-truth box qualifies only when an unmatched query reaches IOU_TAU with it and this box is that query's own best-overlapping partner); for every qualifying box A1 appends that box's OWN native matched pair instead of the candidate, so the appended instance set, its count, the normalisation (num_boxes) and the loss coefficients agree with A2 on the same outputs, and neither arm appends when the gate finds no candidate; A1's appended instances carry the native pair's own (possibly low) regression quality, recorded in the ledger; no claim of equal loss values, gradient magnitudes or regression quality between the arms
frozen_science.band: raw canvas area <= 1024 px^2 on the 768x1344 canvas (normalized area <= 1024/1032192), the same band as the D1 diagnostic and the r18 round; note this canvas-area band is different from the original-image-area APS grouping
frozen_science.regression_only: the extra pairs receive no classification target, so the one-to-one score semantics and the NMS-free output are unchanged; the direct beneficiary box is normally discarded at inference and the declared in-training prediction is that the band's MATCHED pair improves (audited by pos_band_native_iou_sum and pos_band_pairs per family call); registered fact: the appended box under A2 is an unmatched query that keeps its native classification objective (background) - the mechanism adds and changes no classification supervision, and the appended instance itself is not trained to become a detection output
frozen_science.training_budget: 3,648 updates per arm, three arms (A0 native, A1 native matched-pair duplicated-regression control, A2 method), fixed endpoint FT012 EMA-C, no selection and no tuning
frozen_science.schedule_justification: zero new parameters and no new module: the mechanism's gradient path is live from the first update, so the established 12-pass e120 platform measures the direction of the effect; an earlier start or a longer schedule is a separate question and is not used here

observation_protocol.count_semantics: every pos_* count is a matched-pair/instance observation count per family and per criterion call (one ground-truth box contributes once per family per call), not an independent ground-truth count
observation_protocol.post_fork_reporting: after the training fork each arm's counts are reported from its own run by the closeout audit scan; the pre-fork set identity between A1 and A2 is verified on the fixed real input and the CPU fixture, and equality after the fork is not assumed

storage_declaration.note: whole-round estimate includes all preparation and retained failure scenes; no deletion; no artificial stop at this estimate; actual free-disk safety remains

budget.semantics: cost references and legacy parser compatibility only; no artificial resource stop caps
budget.return_bytes_semantics: legacy parser compatibility value only; return hard cap canceled

actual_resource_safety: stop on insufficient disk headroom for the next stage
execution_resource_policy.legacy_cost_fields: numeric budget fields retained for the unchanged release parser; cost_passed/within_budget describe reference comparison only and never scientific quality or stop authority
execution_resource_policy.return_policy: necessary reports, metrics and audit summaries; no artificial byte cap; weights and complete predictions remain server-side by default
